kind: One-off post-release sample availability, not a saved metric or measured speedup; old open clients may still report older code
query:
SELECT count() AS canonical_lcp_events_since_release
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-28 05:53:07')
  AND event = '$web_vitals'
  AND properties.$host IN ('proplane.ai', 'www.proplane.ai')
  AND properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value IS NOT NULL
new_event_taxonomy_verification: Connector lacks action:read scope; new event ingestion not verified through taxonomy endpoint
